h1: Custom Vented T Shirts for Active Teams
metaTitle: Custom Vented T Shirts | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom vented t shirts for your team. Breathable mesh panels keep everyone cool. Bulk pricing available at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Vented t shirts add targeted airflow where your team needs it most — under the arms or across the back — making them ideal for outdoor crews, warehouse staff, and event volunteers working in warm conditions. Unlike standard cotton tees, these shirts use mesh inserts or laser-cut perforations to release heat while maintaining a professional appearance. Decorate with screen-printed logos or embroidered chest marks for a crisp, breathable uniform that keeps your crew comfortable all shift.
heroAltText: Custom vented t shirts with mesh side panels and embroidered logo, perfect for warm-weather uniforms
